senses.definition: An African wild animal like a horse, with black and white stripes.
examples: A herd of zebra crossed the road ahead of us.
No two zebra have exactly the same pattern of stripes.
The zebra is closely related to the horse and the donkey.

senses.definition: The cardinal number occurring before one and that denotes no quantity or amount at all, represented in Arabic numerals as 0.
examples: The conductor waited until the passenger count was zero.
A cheque for zero dollars and zero cents crashed the computers on division by zero.

senses.definition: The numeric symbol that represents the cardinal number zero.
examples: In unary and k-adic notation in general, zero is the empty string.
Write 0.0 to indicate a floating point number rather than the integer zero.
The zero sign in American Sign Language is considered rude in some cultures.

senses.definition: The digit 0 in the decimal, binary, and all other base numbering systems.
examples: One million has six zeroes.
Zero-defect.
The shipment was lost, so they had zero in stock.
He knows zero about humour.

senses.definition: Any given region or area of the world.
A given area distinguished on the basis of a particular characteristic, use, restriction, etc.
examples: There is a no-smoking zone that extends 25 feet outside of each entrance.
The white zone is for loading and unloading only.
Files in the Internet zone are blocked by default, as a security measure.

senses.definition: A restricted category or virtual place.
examples: The discussion was veering off into a danger zone.

senses.definition: A band or area of growth encircling anything.
examples: A zone of evergreens on a mountain.
The zone of animal or vegetable life in the ocean around an island or a continent.

senses.definition: A park where live animals are exhibited.
examples: The London Zoo was built in 1828.

senses.definition: Any place that is wild, crowded, or chaotic.
examples: The shopping center was a zoo the week before Christmas.

senses.definition: A large and varied collection of something.
